name: NuInsSeg: Multi-Organ Multi-Species Nuclei Instance Segmentation Benchmark
description: NuInsSeg is a fully annotated histology benchmark for nuclei instance segmentation in Hematoxylin and Eosin (H&E) stained images. It comprises 665 image patches (512x512 pixels) containing over 30,000 manually segmented nuclei sourced from 31 human and mouse organs spanning diverse healthy and pathological tissue variations. A defining feature of NuInsSeg is the provision of ground-truth ambiguous area masks covering regions where deterministic boundaries cannot be delineated even by human pathology experts, providing a rigorous benchmark for evaluating boundary calibration and uncertain region handling.
